text: The intersection at Cathedral Bluffs Drive and Earl Road is used by students crossing to St. Agatha Catholic School. Cathedral Bluffs Drive runs south off Kingston Road and intersects with a large and busy plaza with high pedestrian and vehicle volumes. To improve community safety in this area, I propose the following recommendation.
The Scarborough Community Council: 1. Authorized the all-way compulsory stop control at the intersection of Cathedral Bluffs Drive and Earl Road.
